scope: Reverse the Pattern B async dispatch tier's producer side. Identify the queue type, the enqueue primitive, and the producer wrappers that game logic uses to fire async events on Element actors. Resolves the open question from the map-tick-handler/fun-004d9910-callers-map/element-vtable8-bulk passes about opcode->event_type encoding.

method.step1: Decomped FUN_004DDB50 (the dequeue primitive from the map-tick-handler pass) and FUN_004DAA10 (the per-frame drainer, BCS-Y-0537) to confirm exact queue field offsets. Queue struct accessed via __thiscall from FUN_004DAA10; queue lives at zone+0x17928 (the dequeue's param_1).
method.step2: Ran FindOffsetWriters.java for offsets 0x17920..0x17944 (zone-relative queue field accesses). Only 2 hits, both in exception unwind handlers - the script misses register+displacement memory operands. Switched to byte-pattern search.
method.step3: Direct PE-binary byte search for 4-byte LE encoding of ring buffer offsets. Found 0x1793c at VA 0x004DBED3 and 0x17940 at VA 0x004DBEE9, both inside FUN_004DBE10.
method.step4: Decomped FUN_004DBE10 - revealed this is the Application::Main::MainModule destructor, and the queue is typed as Sqex::Thread::Queue<Application::Main::MainPacket>::vftable at 0x00F90FDC. Major breakthrough: the 'ring buffer' is a templated thread-safe queue, MainPacket is the 0x60-byte entry, and this is a generic queue type (not Pattern-B-specific).
method.step5: RTTI search for MainPacket symbols yielded Application::Main::MainPacket::vftable at 0x00F90EF8 + Sqex::Thread::Queue<Application::Main::MainPacket>::vftable at 0x00F90FDC. Both vtables have only 1 slot (virtual destructors). Enqueue/Dequeue are non-virtual member functions.
method.step6: Byte-search for MainPacket::vftable found 10 hits in .text, clustered at FUN_004D64A0 (vtable_init) + FUN_004D65E0 (constructor) + FUN_004DDC20 (vector destructor) + 3 game-logic call sites (FUN_0065A760, FUN_006679C0, FUN_007CE7B0). Queue::vftable byte-search found constructor (FUN_004DE080), destructor (FUN_004DDCA0), and 2 init/destroy sites.
method.step7: Decomped FUN_004D65E0 (MainPacket::Construct), FUN_007CE7B0 (the producer wrapper called by 65+ game-logic sites), FUN_007CF7F0 (the actual Sqex::Thread::Queue::Enqueue), FUN_004D66C0 (MainPacket slot-copy primitive), FUN_007CE780 (pre-built MainPacket variant of producer wrapper), FUN_004DE080 (queue ctor).
method.step8: Confirmed event_type encoding: producer adds +3, consumer subtracts -3. FUN_007CE7B0 calls FUN_004D65E0 with event_type=opcode+3. FUN_004DAA10 calls actor->vtable[8](event_type-3, payload, length). So the case values in the element-vtable8-bulk pass's slot-8 dispatchers (e.g. CharaElement cases 0x4A..0x64) ARE the wire opcodes the producer passes; they are NOT s2c packet opcodes - they are internal engine event opcodes generated by game logic on actors.

key_findings: The Pattern B async tier queue IS NOT s2c-packet-driven. It is a generic engine async event bus that game logic uses to fire events on actors.
Queue type: Application::Main::MainModule has a Sqex::Thread::Queue<Application::Main::MainPacket> member at offset 0x17928 (zone+0x17928).
MainPacket layout: 0x60 bytes total. +0x00 vftable / +0x10 actor_id / +0x14 event_type / +0x18 length / +0x20..+0x60 payload (memcpy'd).

Sqex::Thread::Queue struct layout: 0x20 bytes total. +0x00 vftable / +0x04 capacity / +0x08 head_consumer / +0x0C tail_producer / +0x10 depth_counter / +0x14 slot_state_array_ptr (LONG[]) / +0x18 entries_array_ptr (MainPacket[]) / +0x1C reserved.
Slot state values: 0=EMPTY, 1=READY (full), 2=CONSUMING. Producer transitions 0->1, consumer transitions 1->2 then 2->0.
Enqueue primitive: FUN_007CF7F0 (136 bytes). Lock-free CAS on tail cursor + InterlockedExchange of slot state + InterlockedIncrement of depth counter.
Dequeue primitive: FUN_004DDB50 (119 bytes, already cataloged in the map-tick-handler pass as proposed). Mirror of Enqueue: CAS on head cursor + Exchange of slot state.

Producer wrapper FUN_007CE7B0 has 65+ callers across game-logic functions (FUN_006XXXXX..FUN_008XXXXX range). Each call site passes (this, opcode, payload, length) and the wrapper builds+enqueues a MainPacket with event_type=opcode+3. Pattern: game logic fires async actor events.

Event_type encoding: opcode + 3 added by producer (FUN_007CE7B0 line 'param_2 + 3' passed to FUN_004D65E0). FUN_004DAA10 subtracts 3 before dispatch. Net effect: the slot-8 vtable case values ARE the original opcodes the producer passed.

The element-vtable8-bulk pass's case-value interpretation confirmed: CharaElement slot 8 cases (0x4A, 0x4E, 0x50, 0x51, ...) are internal engine event opcodes triggered by game-logic call sites like FUN_006679C0 (Player update) calling FUN_007CE7B0(0x51, ...). These are NOT s2c packet opcodes - the Actor cluster s2c opcodes (0xCC..0xE5) flow through the sync tier (vtable[9]) instead.

Conclusion: Pattern B has TWO functionally separate tiers that happen to share the same Element vtable, with distinct callers and distinct opcode spaces. SYNC tier (vtable[9]) = s2c packet apply, opcodes 0xCC..0xE5; ASYNC tier (vtable[8]) = engine async event bus, opcodes per-class 0x00..0x64.

Type 2 entries: when MainPacket.event_type==2, FUN_004DAA10 routes to `(*(zone+0x17924)->vtable[0x18])(0xffffffff, audio_param, ...)` - a special-cased audio/animation channel call rather than actor dispatch. Producers writing type 2 enqueue audio events.

There exist at least three producer paths: (a) FUN_007CE7B0 - build+enqueue (65+ callers, most common), (b) FUN_007CE780 - enqueue-only (caller already built the MainPacket via FUN_004D65E0), (c) direct FUN_007CF7F0 if caller has already built MainPacket and holds the queue pointer.

fields.description: Number of slots in the ring (passed to FUN_004DE080 constructor as param_2)
Current read cursor. Read by FUN_004DDB50 (Dequeue) via InterlockedExchangeAdd(...,0)
Current write cursor. Read by FUN_007CF7F0 (Enqueue) via InterlockedExchangeAdd(...,0). Advanced via InterlockedCompareExchange after successful slot grab
Number of ready entries. InterlockedIncrement by enqueue, InterlockedDecrement by drainer
Each LONG: 0=EMPTY, 1=READY, 2=CONSUMING. Allocated as `new int[capacity]` in FUN_004DE080. Producer: Exchange 0->1. Consumer: Exchange 1->2 then 2->0
0x60 bytes per entry. Allocated as `new MainPacket[capacity]` with vector-constructor-iterator. Allocation has 16-byte header for capacity tracking
5 unwind-handler refs hit this offset; likely cleanup/teardown bookkeeping
First 16 bytes of packet are not used by the dispatcher (likely RTTI/sentinel)
Actor ID for FUN_004D9910 lookup. Often passed as 0 for zone-level/broadcast events. Producers set via FUN_004D65E0 param_2
Opcode + 3. Decoded as opcode = event_type - 3 by FUN_004DAA10. Special value: 2 routes to audio/animation channel instead of actor dispatch
memcpy size for payload. Passed as 3rd arg to actor->vtable[8]
Inline payload bytes. memcpy'd from producer's source. Passed as 2nd arg to actor->vtable[8]

proposed_bcs_y_entries.summary: Application::Main::MainPacket per-element ctor: writes vftable only (7 bytes). Called by eh_vector_constructor_iterator during queue array allocation

proposed_bcs_y_entries.name: MainPacket_Construct_FUN_004D65E0
proposed_bcs_y_entries.summary: Application::Main::MainPacket::Construct(this, actor_id, event_type, payload, length) - 58 bytes. Writes vftable + actor_id (+0x10) + event_type (+0x14) + length (+0x18), memcpys payload to +0x20. Called by 3 sites: FUN_006679C0 (Player update), FUN_007CE7B0 (producer wrapper), FUN_0065A760 (direct Player event)

proposed_bcs_y_entries.name: MainPacket_CopyIntoSlot_FUN_004D66C0
proposed_bcs_y_entries.summary: Copies a MainPacket (+0x10, +0x14, +0x18, and memcpy of +0x20 with size from source +0x18) from producer-local buffer into queue slot. Called by FUN_007CF7F0 (Enqueue) after CAS-acquiring the slot

proposed_bcs_y_entries.name: Sqex_Thread_Queue_MainPacket_Enqueue_FUN_007CF7F0
proposed_bcs_y_entries.summary: Sqex::Thread::Queue<MainPacket>::Enqueue - 136 bytes. Lock-free push: read tail (Interlocked), check slot_state==0 (EMPTY), CAS-advance tail, copy MainPacket into slot (FUN_004D66C0), Exchange slot_state to 1 (READY), Increment depth. Returns 1 on success, 0 on full/contention

proposed_bcs_y_entries.name: Sqex_Thread_Queue_MainPacket_Dequeue_FUN_004DDB50
proposed_bcs_y_entries.summary: Sqex::Thread::Queue<MainPacket>::Dequeue - 119 bytes. Lock-free pop: read head (Interlocked), check slot_state==1 (READY), CAS-advance head, Exchange slot_state to 2 (CONSUMING), return entries[head]. Called from FUN_004DAA10 (drainer)

proposed_bcs_y_entries.name: Sqex_Thread_Queue_MainPacket_Ctor_FUN_004DE080
proposed_bcs_y_entries.summary: Sqex::Thread::Queue<MainPacket>::Queue(capacity) - 271 bytes. Installs vftable at +0x00, capacity at +0x04, allocates slot_state_array (capacity*4 bytes) at +0x14 via vector_constructor_iterator(FUN_0044D340), allocates entries array (capacity*0x60 + 16-byte header) via eh_vector_constructor_iterator(FUN_004DDC80, FUN_004D64A0). Called by FUN_004DC3A0 (zone setup)

proposed_bcs_y_entries.name: Sqex_Thread_Queue_MainPacket_Dtor_FUN_004DDCA0
proposed_bcs_y_entries.summary: Sqex::Thread::Queue<MainPacket>::~Queue - 18 bytes. Restores vftable, frees the slot_state_array at +0x14 via _free. Note: the entries array at +0x18 has its own free path

proposed_bcs_y_entries.name: Engine_AsyncActorEvent_Producer_Wrapper_FUN_007CE7B0
proposed_bcs_y_entries.summary: The dominant producer wrapper for the Pattern B async event bus. 191 bytes. Signature: bool FUN_007CE7B0(this, opcode, payload, length). Acquires thread-safety via FUN_0060B2A0, builds MainPacket on stack via FUN_004D65E0 with event_type=opcode+3 (the +3 that gets undone by -3 in FUN_004DAA10), enqueues via FUN_007CF7F0. Has 65+ callers across game-logic functions (FUN_006XXXXX..FUN_008XXXXX range). Each caller fires a specific opcode (e.g. FUN_006679C0 fires opcode 0x51 -> CharaElement::slot8 case 0x51)

proposed_bcs_y_entries.name: Engine_AsyncActorEvent_Producer_PrebuiltVariant_FUN_007CE780
proposed_bcs_y_entries.summary: Producer wrapper variant - takes a pre-built MainPacket (caller has already invoked FUN_004D65E0). 41 bytes. Acquires thread-safety, calls FUN_007CF7F0 directly. Used when caller builds the MainPacket on stack with custom params (e.g. for type=2 audio events). 2 callers: FUN_0065A760, FUN_006679C0

proposed_bcs_y_entries.name: Engine_ThreadSafety_Check_FUN_0060B2A0
proposed_bcs_y_entries.summary: Thread-safety check used by Pattern B async producer wrappers. 7 bytes. Returns *(this+0xB0). When nonzero, producer proceeds; when zero, producer drops the event. Called by FUN_007CE7B0 and FUN_007CE780

proposed_bcs_s_entries.name: Sqex_Thread_Queue_MainPacket_struct_layout
proposed_bcs_s_entries.summary: Sqex::Thread::Queue<MainPacket> 8-field layout (0x20 bytes). The Pattern B async event bus queue. Hosted at zone+0x17928 inside Application::Main::MainModule. Lock-free CAS-based push/pop with 3-state slot machine (0=EMPTY, 1=READY, 2=CONSUMING).

proposed_bcs_s_entries.name: Application_Main_MainPacket_struct_layout
proposed_bcs_s_entries.summary: Application::Main::MainPacket 7-field layout (0x60 bytes). The Pattern B async event payload. +0x10 actor_id / +0x14 event_type / +0x18 payload_length / +0x20..0x60 inline payload bytes.
